title: NAT-Whitelist DiscordAddon
description: Easily connect with a Discord bot
body:
# NAT-Whitelist-DiscordAddon

A Discord integration addon for the NAT-Whitelist Minecraft plugin. This addon enables whitelist management through Discord bot commands.

## Features

- MySQL/MariaDB database support
- Multi-language support (English & French)
- Links Discord users to Minecraft accounts
- Seamless integration with NAT-Whitelist core plugin

## Requirements

- Minecraft server with Bukkit/Spigot/Paper
- NAT-Whitelist core plugin installed
- MySQL or MariaDB database

## Installation

1. Install the NAT-Whitelist core plugin
2. Place the addon JAR in your plugins folder
3. Configure your Discord bot token in `config.yml`
4. Restart your server

## Configuration

Set your Discord bot token and language preference in the `config.yml` file. Database settings are inherited from the NAT-Whitelist core plugin.
